fieldHint.notifyOnMute: Raise a notification when a channel is muted or unmuted on the desk.

rodecaster.exclusive: The USB cable must reach the machine running the core, and the desk allows one client at a time — RØDE Central and RØDE Connect cannot be open while this connector holds it.

middlecontrol.help: Middle Control must remain running. If it runs on the Metocast server computer, use localhost — no IP address is needed. Current macOS versions use port 11584; the observed 3.2.0 macOS build uses 11581; Windows uses 11580.
middlecontrol.devicesDisconnected: Connect Middle Control to see its cameras and APC-R PTZ units.
middlecontrol.devicesWaiting: Waiting for the first Middle Control feedback frame…
middlecontrol.devicesEmpty: Middle Control reports no connected cameras or APC-R PTZ units.
middlecontrol.discoveryDescription: Checks this computer and the Metocast server's local network on the known Middle Control ports. Only a valid feedback stream is accepted.
middlecontrol.discoveryReady: Start a scan while Middle Control is running.
middlecontrol.discoveryEmpty: No Middle Control instance answered. Make sure it is running, then scan again. For manual entry, on its Mac open System Settings → Network and select the active connection; on Windows open Settings → Network & internet → Properties. Copy the IPv4 address into Host above.

status.atem_no_ack: The switcher did not confirm the command
status.atem_unknown_input: The switcher has no such input

atem.controlMeta: Program, preview, cut, record and stream
atem.discoveryDescription: Looks for ATEM switchers connected to the Metocast server over USB or on its local network.
atem.discoveryReady: Start a scan with the switcher powered on and connected by USB or Ethernet.
atem.discoveryEmpty: No switcher answered. Check its USB or network cable, then scan again. For manual entry, find its IP address in ATEM Setup and type it into Host above.

camera.notConnected: The Blackmagic camera connector is not connected. Enable it under Connectors and scan for the camera.
camera.note: Settings are staged here and written to the camera when you apply. Recording and streaming keep running on whatever the camera already has.

rodecaster.title: RØDECaster Pro II
rodecaster.notConnected: The RØDECaster is not connected. Attach it to the machine running the core, enable the connector, and make sure no other application holds the device.
rodecaster.cue: Cue is on for this channel.
rodecaster.noSettings: The device reports no further properties for this channel.
rodecaster.note: Everything here is read from the desk. Mute is the only value this app writes.

recording.title: Audio recording
recording.description: Metocast Core records the audio and writes the FLAC files. Enable recording, choose an existing folder on the computer running the Core, then save these settings. If this app connects to a remote Core, enter an absolute path on that remote computer.
recording.enabledHint: Capture the RØDECaster USB multitrack endpoint as lossless FLAC.
recording.endpointUnavailable: Metocast cannot find the RØDECaster multitrack audio input. Connect the computer running Metocast Core to USB 1 on the mixer, enable USB 1 Multitrack on the RØDECaster, then scan again.
recording.directoryHint: Choose an existing folder on this computer. The Core must be able to write to it.
recording.remoteHint: Enter an absolute path to an existing writable folder on the remote computer running Metocast Core.
recording.sourcesRequired: Select at least one fader track for this output mode.
recording.sourcesUnavailable: No individual fader tracks were discovered. Enable USB 1 Multitrack on the RØDECaster, then scan again.

switcher.title: Switcher control
switcher.notConnected: The Blackmagic ATEM connector is not connected. Enable it under Connectors and enter the switcher's IP address.
switcher.note: Program and preview follow the switcher, including changes made on its panel or in ATEM Software Control.
